title: Restriction naturality of ordinary diagonal realization coordinates
statement: Fix the finite coefficient datum $P$ of [def-pur-conventions]. Let $f:X\to Y$ be separated and finite type with a compactification, let $a_Y:Y\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ be finite type, and let $d\ge0$. Let $V^{\prime}\subseteq V$ be affine opens of $Y$. Write $j_V:f^{-1}V\to X$, $j_{V^{\prime}}:f^{-1}V^{\prime}\to X$ and $i:f^{-1}V^{\prime}\to f^{-1}V$ for the inclusions. Use the ordinary dualizing object $M$ and ordered Tate object $N=A_X(d)[2d]$ of [def-pur-diagonal-dualizing-data], and exact ordinary restriction $R_j$ and realization $\operatorname{realize}_V$ of [lem-pur-diagonal-ordinary-chart-lift]. For every isomorphism $b:R_{j_V}M\cong R_{j_V}N$, let $c:R_iR_{j_V}\cong R_{j_{V^{\prime}}}$ be the ordinary open compositor of [lem-pur-degree-zero-derived-map-gluing], and put $b^{\prime}=c_N\circ R_i(b)\circ c_M^{-1}$. With the source-composition map $s$ of [lem-pur-diagonal-orientation-refinement], and the specified pullback and Tate transport of [def-pur-orientation-refinement-comparisons], one has $\operatorname{realize}_{V^{\prime}}(b^{\prime})=\operatorname{tate}(i,a_Y\circ V.\iota\circ(f|_V),d)\circ Li^*(\operatorname{realize}_V(b))\circ s^{-1}$. Composition in this paragraph has the usual mathematical order: the rightmost factor acts first. This is an identity for arbitrary b; it assumes no smoothness, chart, family, agreement equation or descent assertion.

proof.text: Expand realization. For comparison composition, use the proved comparison_pullback_coherent equation on ordinary sheaves and mapDerivedCategorySquareIso_hom_app_comp to derive it termwise. Naturality of leftDerivedFunctorIsoMapDerivedCategory converts the exact derived pro-etale compositor into leftDerivedUpperStarComp. Substitution of homOfLE_ι gives comparison_openComp. Naturality moves the specified unit conversion and arbitrary ordinary arrow b through this square.

Write the specified Tate transport as the comparison square followed by the exact ordinary ordered Tate pullback. Apply the ordinary nested-open composition identity of lem-pur-ordered-tate-exact-open-composition. Naturality of comparison then proves tate_openComp. This is the only remaining mathematical input: it concerns only the ordered coefficient, not a dualizing object, site comparison or arbitrary arrow.

Precompose the desired equality by sourceComposition. Use its naturality on the unit conversion and comparison_openComp on the ordinary source; cancel the ordinary open compositor and use comparison naturality on b. Use tate_openComp and comparison_openComp on the target, cancelling adjacent inverses. The structure maps agree by morphismRestrict_ι.

theorem realize_restriction (P : PurityFiniteSetting.{u}) {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    [HasCompactification f]
    (aY : Y ⟶ Spec (.of P.field.k)) [LocallyOfFiniteType aY] [QuasiCompact aY]
    (d : ℕ) {V V' : Y.affineOpens} (h : V'.1 ≤ V.1)
    (b : (restrict P (f ⁻¹ᵁ V.1).ι).obj (P.diagonalOrdinaryDualizing f) ≅
      (restrict P (f ⁻¹ᵁ V.1).ι).obj (P.diagonalTwistEtale X d)) :
    let c := DegreeZeroMapGluing.openComp
      (fun T : Scheme.{u} ↦ Sheaf T.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient))
      (fun {_ _} j ↦ Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient) j)
      (fun {_ _ _} i j ↦ Etale.upperStarComp (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient) i j)
      X (f.preimage_mono h)
    realize P f aY d V'
        ((c.app (P.diagonalOrdinaryDualizing f)).symm ≪≫
          (restrict P (OrientationRefinement.inclusion f h)).mapIso b ≪≫
          c.app (P.diagonalTwistEtale X d)) =
      (OrientationRefinement.sourceComposition P f aY h).symm ≪≫
        (OrientationRefinement.pull P (OrientationRefinement.inclusion f h)).mapIso
          (realize P f aY d V b) ≪≫
        OrientationRefinement.tate P (OrientationRefinement.inclusion f h)
          ((f ∣_ V.1) ≫ V.1.ι ≫ aY) d
